label: localised, edit failed
justification: The submission scored 0.096, well below the 0.29 needed for success. Loop evidence: call 16 printed the start and last 1000 characters of a generation cut at 32,768 tokens. Calls 37 and 47 printed more cut-off texts; call 47's output shows the same line repeated near the end ('If she sold to 48 friends, she sold 48 clips'). Locus: in call 46 the editor split generations into cut_at_max_tokens (16) and finished (4), and call 48 compared per-layer MLP neuron activations between the two groups. This pointed to layer-23 neurons that differ between looping and finished texts. Calls 68-71 also compared attention entropy between a cut-off text and a finished text. This is not fully clean, since the groups are small and the activations are mean-over-answer, but it does separate looping from non-looping. The edits followed from this and none repaired the failure: layer-23 down_proj suppress/boost (about 0.05-0.14 on small samples), layer-19 down_proj, a layer-7 head-6 o_proj ablation, a layer-3 gate_proj edit, and the final layer-23 gate_proj edit. That final edit gave only about +5 points on GSM8K and about 0 on mixed MATH (8.6% vs 8.2%), and it was submitted anyway.
edits_tried: layer 20 MLP down_proj neuron scale-down (call 32); layer 23 down_proj suppress/boost (calls 49, 51, 93, 94, 99); layer 19 down_proj (call 96); layer 7 head-6 o_proj ablation (call 72); layer 3 gate_proj (call 76); layer 23 gate_proj suppress/boost (call 103, kept and submitted); stronger layer-23 gate_proj variant (call 155, reverted)
